name: model-routing
title: Model routing
description: Start each agent session on a model chosen by its Start agent mode, set a subagent model, and offer one tier up after a task failed its verify twice.

ticket_options.label: Next start on the Strong model
ticket_options.help: Applies to the next session you start on this ticket, then turns itself off. A running session keeps its model.

settings_schema.label: Light model (optional): a Claude Code model name, e.g. haiku
Standard model: a Claude Code model name, e.g. sonnet
Strong model: a Claude Code model name, e.g. opus
Tier for Work on ticket (a Standard model of opusplan plans on Opus, builds on Sonnet)
Tier for Continue after feedback (same: the tier of the last start on the ticket)
Subagent model for every session (CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL), e.g. haiku
